Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Shakti Cement

Dear Shakti Cement Team,

Following a mechanical breakdown, a replacement vehicle (Reg: PB74TA4257) has been dispatched from our Ludhiana hub.
The vehicle is currently en route to Chandigarh with an estimated arrival time of approximately 2.9 hours.
This adjustment ensures we remain within the agreed 36-hour door-to-door delivery window for your shipment.
We will continue to monitor the transit and provide further updates as needed.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
